paragraphs.source_en: At ten o’clock Milady began to appear restless. D’Artagnan knew what she wanted. She looked at the clock, rose, reseated herself, smiled at D’Artagnan with an air which said, “You are very amiable, no doubt, but you would be *charming* if you would only depart.”

paragraphs.source_en: This time Kitty was nowhere waiting for him; neither in the antechamber, nor in the corridor, nor beneath the great door.
